candidate: China Telecom Lingang Information Park Phase 2.1

selected_locator.precision: Approximate representative point inside the named Phase 2 parent property, rounded to four decimals. It does not locate the Phase 2.1 buildings, active work, entrance, surveyed centroid, parcel boundary or Phase 1 property.
selected_locator.identity_review: CSCEC explicitly confirms Phase 2.1. The authority-approved Phase 2 plan names the same project and shows a unique property east of Runhe Road, west of Yebo Road, south of Canghong Road and north of Zongqi River. The consultation drawing confirms these four limits. Runhe/Canghong and Runhe/Zhoude junctions anchor the plan, with Runhe/Danyi withheld as a check. No Phase 1 F07-01 point is used.
selected_locator.uncertainty_reason: The plan and community road map provide no measured absolute accuracy. Two fit controls and the withheld check are collinear; the official north-up 1:750 plan supports isotropic scale, but the 8.44 m residual does not independently verify east-west or absolute ground accuracy. Rounded point denotes only the broad Phase 2 property.

controls.label: Runhe / Zhoude road centerline intersection
controls.derivation: midpoint of northbound/southbound Zhoude carriageway intersection nodes

transform.target_complex: east + i*north in local metric frame
transform.formula: target_ground = coefficient * (source_complex - source_origin_complex); lon = origin_lon + east / metres_per_degree_longitude; lat = origin_lat + north / metres_per_degree_latitude

registration.area_check_note: Rough hand-picked outline is solely a scale sanity check; not emitted as a boundary or project footprint.
limitations: Only a coarse representative marker for the full named Phase 2 parent property.

Two fit controls determine a similarity transform; the third collinear road junction checks along-road consistency but does not independently validate east-west scale. The printed 1:750 plan scale and north arrow support isotropic scale; no affine warp or unknown-datum survey coordinate conversion is used.
OSM roads are community mapping with no surveyed positional accuracy; the 8-10 m check residual is not a ground-accuracy claim.
Phase 2.1 building position, active construction extent and facility boundary are not asserted.

visual_review.source_survey_system_note: The plan says Shanghai city plane coordinates and Wusong elevations; no datum transformation is inferred or applied. Registration uses drawn road centerlines and OSM WGS84 junctions.

phase_scope_exclusions: Phase 1 F07-01 lies beyond Zhoude Road south of this property and is not substituted.
Full Phase 2 design includes planned B1-B6 data-center buildings, support buildings and substation. Shell status is attached only to the contractor-described Phase 2.1 scope.
No full-property completion, operation, phase capacity or footprint is inferred.
geometry_rights_scope: The derived point uses OpenStreetMap numeric road controls and is attributed to OpenStreetMap contributors under ODbL-1.0. The official plan remains separately attributed identity/shape context with its own source terms; no plan or boundary is redistributed.
